Xbox Hub private-source build validation trigger
Request: validate offline manifest signing success and negative security cases
Source version: 0.1.7-preview.1
Source commit: afb0b80f724400cc30173790b70ce3f3cee3413f
Scope: Windows x64 restore, self-contained app/updater publish, exact two-file package validation, parser-only signing helper checks, ephemeral RSA-3072 signing and independent verification, rejection of wrong package digest/cross-host URL/mismatched key ID, and updater transaction tests.
Security: only throwaway CI key is used in temporary runner storage and deleted. No production key or credential is used. No private source, packages, artifacts, signing keys, TLS keys, or Cloudflare tokens are uploaded.
